verdict.rationale: GitCafe's own capabilities let code leave in open Git format: any Git client works over HTTPS/SSH, and branches can be mirrored to another Git server. Two-way GitHub sync can also carry issues and pull requests out to GitHub. There is no documented full-account export or archive of all data (issues, reviews, comments, settings) in open formats; the REST API and JSON CLI output are only building blocks. Missing for 10: a dedicated complete data export, open-format export of issues/PRs/reviews independent of GitHub, and hands-on corroboration of leaving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: GitCafe repositories work with any Git client over HTTPS or SSH.
Mirror a branch with another Git server
Import from GitHub and keep code, issues, and pull requests in sync, one way or both.
